title: Window Actions And Tools Contract
description:
Formalize the per-window action/tool contract: every window has ACTIONS (non-interactive effects with optional arguments exposed as staged input UI below an action panel; no effect on window/document before execution) and TOOLS (interactive effects with live preview inside the window). Both may emit operations on the document; operations are what the VCS tracks and synchronizes.

Full plan (9 architecture decisions + 4 workstreams WS-1..WS-4) is at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-sure-that-os-gleaming-stonebraker.md (the Window Actions & Tools Contract section, appended after the completed OS+VCS+Hub CQRS refactor). Summary:
- WS-1: type/contract layer (framework/core, ui_wgpu, framework/plugin, WIT, TS) — typed ActionArgDef replacing dormant args_schema, ToolDefinition registry replacing ad-hoc ToolNode trees, active-tool as host-owned ephemeral ViewState, VcsDocumentApp contract enforcement (required args, kind discipline).
- WS-2: React shell — per-window staged action panel, palette/keybinding redirect, tool activation UX.
- WS-3: wgpu shell — same UX with parity, plus net-new app-keybinding dispatch.
- WS-4: plugin fleet migration (~25 plugins) in waves — author/extend action+tool registries, delete document-resident active-tool state (draw/cad/note), fix mis-declared actions, fix uncoalesced per-tick ops.

This is a large multi-session effort building directly on the just-completed OS+VCS+Hub CQRS refactor (same plugin fleet, same DocumentApp/ActionEmit contract). This ticket tracks the whole effort across many implementation sessions.
